args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the latest deploy, checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of 18%. The v2.3.1-rc build had also been marked unhealthy in staging. I rolled checkout-api back in all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. After the rollback, all regions run v2.3.0, the service reports healthy, and the error rate is down to 0.2%. Next steps: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 regression before redeploying it.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again.

- **Problem:** v2.3.1 was live in us-east, us-west and eu-west, failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) had also been marked unhealthy in staging.
- **Rollback:** I chose v2.3.0 because it's the most recent release that was healthy in production. It's now running in all three regions. The service reports healthy and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** I opened SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api, which paged on-call. It describes the failure, the rollback and the recovery, and says someone needs to find the cause of the v2.3.1 problem before it's deployed again.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
